import requests, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
API='https://talod.miraheze.org/w/api.php'
s=requests.Session()
s.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Takeru-Sync/1.0'})
# Search for all country-like pages by searching allpages
r=s.get(API,params={'action':'query','list':'allpages','aplimit':500,'apfrom':'A','format':'json'},timeout=30)
pages=r.json().get('query',{}).get('allpages',[])
countries=['Andalus','Balisca','Burawa','Dagit','Echia','Nakamizu','Okaiken','Varkana','United Midlands','Qym','Geno','Toju','Balausia','Daramazan','Charxes','Castramara','Bayara','Brasal']
found=[]
for p in pages:
    if p['title'] in countries:
        found.append(p['title'])
# Continue
cont=r.json().get('continue',{}).get('apcontinue','')
while cont and cont < 'Z':
    r=s.get(API,params={'action':'query','list':'allpages','aplimit':500,'apfrom':cont,'format':'json'},timeout=30)
    pages=r.json().get('query',{}).get('allpages',[])
    for p in pages:
        if p['title'] in countries:
            found.append(p['title'])
    cont=r.json().get('continue',{}).get('apcontinue','')
    if not cont or cont > 'Z':
        break
print('Countries found on wiki:', sorted(set(found)))
# Also search for 'Breisland' variants
for c in ['Breisland','Breislandia','Breis','Bresland','Breslau']:
    r2=s.get(API,params={'action':'query','titles':c,'format':'json'},timeout=10)
    pages2=r2.json().get('query',{}).get('pages',{})
    for pid,info in pages2.items():
        if pid!='-1':
            print(f'  {c}: EXISTS')
